name: OrganizationSpec
description: OrganizationSpec defines the configurable properties of an organization.

fields.name: LogoUrl
fields.description: Public URL for the organization logo.

fields.name: ExternalId
fields.description:
The parent's own identifier for this organization, such as the
 customer id an integrator keeps for it ("cust-4411").

fields.name: Preferences
fields.description: Standing preferences declared by the organization.

fields.name: ParentOrg
fields.description:
The organization this one is a child of, by id or slug; empty for an
 organization that has no parent.
